site.name: Pet Smart Device Decisions
site.tagline: Smart pet devices - automatic litter boxes, pet cameras and GPS trackers: Litter-Robot, Furbo, Petcube, Tractive and Pawfit prices, plans and policies, with every fact read from the brand's own official page and shown with its source URL and check date.

home_facts.fact: Litter-Robot publishes starting prices of $699 for Litter-Robot 4, $799 for Litter-Robot 5 and $899 for Litter-Robot 5 Pro, each shown as 'As low as' on its own product page.
home_facts.condition: 'As low as' figures printed on each model's page on litter-robot.com; bundles and add-ons are priced separately and the site currently banners '$75 off select Litter-Robot bundles'.

home_facts.fact: Furbo lists the Furbo 360° Dog Camera and the Furbo 360° Cat Camera at $54 each, both showing 'original price is $184'.
home_facts.condition: Displayed on furbo.com/us product pages on the check date; the page also offers $10 off your first Furbo by e-mail sign-up and a free-camera trial that requires paying shipping.

home_facts.fact: Petcube's own store prices: Petcube Cam $26.99 (was $34.99), Cam 360 $34.99 (was $52.99), Play 2 $64.99 (was $99.00), Bites 2 Lite $79.99 (was $149.99) and Petcube GPS Tracker $29.99 (was $52.99).
home_facts.condition: Current and struck-through prices shown in Petcube's device menu and product pages on the check date; a site banner reads 'Save up to $67 on smart pet tech'.

home_facts.fact: Tractive sells its DOG 6 tracker from 69 € and states that 'the subscription price is separate from the tracker'; the cheapest plan it lists is a 2-Year Basic plan from 5 € per month (120 € billed every 2 years).
home_facts.condition: Tracker price from the DOG 6 product page and plan prices from the plans page on tractive.com/en, both read on the check date; Tractive notes 'Pricing may vary depending on location'.

home_facts.fact: Pawfit sells the Pawfit 3 tracker for £54.99 plus a subscription: the cheapest listed plan is Basic at £3.99 per month billed £95.76 every 2 years, and the top Premium 3-Year plan is £3.99 per month billed £143.64 every 3 years.
home_facts.condition: Prices printed on pawfit.com's Pawfit 3 page (UK store, GBP); Pawfit also states 30-day money back, 18-month warranty and free delivery on that page.

home_facts.fact: Litter-Robot includes a 90-day in-home trial with a full refund minus return shipping, Petcube advertises a 45-day money-back policy on store purchases, and both Tractive and Pawfit publish a 30-day money-back guarantee.
home_facts.condition: Each figure is the brand's own published return window: litter-robot.com/money-back-guarantee.html, Petcube's store FAQ, tractive.com plans page and pawfit.com's Pawfit 3 page.

home_faqs.q: How much does an automatic litter box cost on the brand's own site?
home_faqs.a: Litter-Robot publishes 'As low as' prices of $699 for Litter-Robot 4, $799 for Litter-Robot 5 and $899 for Litter-Robot 5 Pro, and lists a 90-day in-home trial with a full refund minus return shipping.

home_faqs.q: How much does a Furbo pet camera cost?
home_faqs.a: Furbo lists both the Furbo 360° Dog Camera and the Furbo 360° Cat Camera at $54 with 'original price is $184', and its Furbo Nanny subscription starts at $9.99 per month monthly or $6.99 per month on the yearly plan for the Standard tier.

home_faqs.q: Do pet GPS trackers need a monthly subscription?
home_faqs.a: Tractive says explicitly that 'the subscription price is separate from the tracker' and prices plans from 5 € per month on a 2-Year Basic plan; Pawfit likewise sells the Pawfit 3 '£54.99 + Subscription Plan' with Basic and Premium plans. Petcube, by contrast, prices its GPS Tracker as a $29.99 device purchase.

home_faqs.q: How long can I try a smart pet device before I'm stuck with it?
home_faqs.a: Litter-Robot publishes a 90-day in-home trial (return within 90 days for a full refund, just pay return shipping; returned units must be clean or a cleaning fee applies), Petcube publishes a 45-day money-back policy for purchases on Petcube.com, and Tractive and Pawfit each publish a 30-day money-back guarantee.

home_faqs.q: Are any of these devices HSA/FSA eligible?
home_faqs.a: Litter-Robot's own product page states the unit is HSA/FSA eligible, with eligibility determined per customer through Flex after a brief telehealth consultation approved within 24 hours; the other brands' pages checked on the same date publish no such claim, so none is made for them here.

home_faqs.q: What warranty does each brand publish?
home_faqs.a: Litter-Robot includes 1 year of WhiskerCare coverage and offers a 3-year extension for $129 on Litter-Robot 4 ($149 on Litter-Robot 5); Furbo publishes a 1 Year Warranty with free US shipping and free returns within 30 days; Petcube warrants products for one year in the US and Canada and two years in the EU and UK; Pawfit publishes an 18-month warranty.

brands.name: Litter-Robot
brands.short_answer: Litter-Robot (Whisker) sells self-cleaning litter boxes directly on litter-robot.com with published 'As low as' prices: $699 for Litter-Robot 4, $799 for Litter-Robot 5 and $899 for Litter-Robot 5 Pro. Every unit ships with a 90-day in-home trial and 1 year of WhiskerCare coverage, and the site currently runs a '$75 off select Litter-Robot bundles' banner.
brands.price_condition: Litter-Robot 4 is listed as 'As low as $699' on its product page; Litter-Robot 5 is 'As low as $799' and Litter-Robot 5 Pro 'As low as $899' on their own pages. The homepage also shows 'Starting at just $44/mo' financing. Bundles, the LitterHopper ($129) and the 3-year WhiskerCare extension ($129 on LR4, $149 on LR5) are priced separately, and the '$75 off select bundles' banner can change or end without notice.

facts.fact: Litter-Robot 4 is listed as 'As low as $699' on its product page.
facts.condition: Base unit price shown on litter-robot.com/litter-robot-4.html on the check date; the page also shows 'Color Bezels now only $35' as an add-on.

facts.fact: Litter-Robot 5 is listed as 'As low as $799' with the note 'Selling fast: Order now, ships in 1-3 days'.
facts.condition: Shown on the Litter-Robot 5 product page; the page shows a 4.6/5.0 rating from 241 reviews.

facts.fact: Litter-Robot 5 Pro is listed as 'As low as $899' with a 4.4/5.0 rating from 301 reviews.
facts.condition: Shown on the Litter-Robot 5 Pro product page on the check date.

facts.fact: Litter-Robot includes a 90-day in-home trial: return within 90 days for a full refund, just pay return shipping.
facts.condition: Whisker Founder's Guarantee page: returned units must be clean, and a cleaning fee is applied if they are returned with litter or waste.

facts.fact: Every Litter-Robot includes 1 year of WhiskerCare coverage; a 3-year WhiskerCare plan costs $129 on Litter-Robot 4 and $149 on Litter-Robot 5.
facts.condition: Warranty selector on each product page ('1 Year Included / 3 Years $129' on LR4, '$149' on LR5); Whisker says the plan covers the robot top-to-bottom with no deductibles and free shipping both ways.

facts.fact: Whisker offers 0% APR financing through Affirm on eligible purchases, with plans of 3, 6, 12 or 18 months.
facts.condition: Published on the payment options page; approval and terms are determined by Affirm. Other listed payment methods are credit cards, Shop Pay, Amazon Pay and PayPal.

facts.fact: Litter-Robot's product page states the unit is HSA/FSA eligible.
facts.condition: Eligibility is determined per customer through Flex after a brief telehealth consultation, approved within 24 hours; the page notes 'not all customers qualify, and FSA eligibility may vary by employer plan'.

facts.fact: Litter-Robot 4 ships free (excluding AK/HI/PR) and shows a 4.5/5.0 rating from 14,094 reviews.
facts.condition: Shipping note and review counter displayed on the Litter-Robot 4 product page on the check date.

facts.fact: Whisker's FAQ says Litter-Robot works best with standard-weight clumping clay litter such as GreatLitter, and that plant-based, non-clumping and wood pellet litters typically do not work.
facts.condition: Verbatim guidance from the pre-purchase FAQ: silica gel crystals can work if they pass the screen, but translucent/white litters may affect litter-level and drawer-full indicator accuracy.

facts.fact: Whisker's FAQ says Litter-Robot 5 adds WasteID (distinguishing urine from feces), an LCD display, a 3-30 lb cat weight range and support for up to 5 cats, on top of Litter-Robot 4's SmartScale weight ID and litter- and waste-level sensing.
facts.condition: Differences listed in the FAQ answer to 'What is the difference between Litter-Robot 4 and Litter-Robot 5?'; some features require Whisker+ and optimize after about 30 days of use.

faqs.q: How much does a Litter-Robot cost?
faqs.a: Litter-Robot publishes 'As low as' prices of $699 for Litter-Robot 4, $799 for Litter-Robot 5 and $899 for Litter-Robot 5 Pro, and shows financing from about $44 per month.

faqs.q: Can I return a Litter-Robot if my cat won't use it?
faqs.a: Yes - Whisker publishes a 90-day in-home trial: return within 90 days for a full refund, paying return shipping. Returned units must be clean, and a cleaning fee applies if they come back with litter or waste.

faqs.q: What warranty is included?
faqs.a: 1 year of WhiskerCare coverage is included with every unit; a 3-year WhiskerCare plan costs $129 on Litter-Robot 4 and $149 on Litter-Robot 5, covers the robot top-to-bottom with no deductibles and includes free shipping both ways.

faqs.q: Does Litter-Robot require special litter?
faqs.a: Whisker recommends a standard-weight clumping clay litter such as GreatLitter. Non-clumping, loose-clumping, newspaper-based and wood pellet litters typically do not work because they do not filter properly through the sifting system.

faqs.q: Can I pay over time?
faqs.a: Whisker offers 0% APR financing through Affirm on eligible purchases with 3, 6, 12 or 18-month plans, alongside credit cards, Shop Pay, Amazon Pay and PayPal.

faqs.q: Is Litter-Robot HSA/FSA eligible?
faqs.a: Litter-Robot's product page states HSA/FSA eligibility; eligibility is determined per customer through Flex after a brief telehealth consultation, approved within 24 hours, and varies by employer plan.

faqs.q: How much does Pawfit cost?
faqs.a: The Pawfit 3 tracker is £54.99 plus a subscription: Basic from £3.99/month (billed £95.76 every 2 years) up to £9.99/month monthly, or Premium from £3.99/month (billed £143.64 every 3 years) up to £6.99/month billed yearly.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Basic and Premium?
faqs.a: Both include live location updates every 5 seconds, unlimited range, 24-hour history, activity monitoring, safety zones and family sharing. Premium raises the single tracked-walk duration from 2 hours to 6 hours and lists more consistent location update rates during walk tracking.

faqs.q: Can I get my money back?
faqs.a: Pawfit publishes a 30-day money-back guarantee, an 18-month warranty and free delivery on the Pawfit 3 product page.

faqs.q: How often does the tracker update location?
faqs.a: Pawfit states live location tracking updates every 5 seconds, with a Bluetooth-based Find Nearby mode for pinpoint accuracy indoors.

faqs.q: Does Pawfit work for cats?
faqs.a: Yes - Pawfit's FAQ says Pawfit 3 is a lightweight tracker that can be used for cats, and the site sells a separate cat tracker range; the same FAQ notes the tracker uses 4G, so adequate network coverage is needed.

faqs.q: How many pets can I track on one account?
faqs.a: Pawfit's app feature list says you can track up to 20 pets at once, with family sharing so several people can look after the same dog.
